analysis.title: Daily Tech Index
key_insights: SPX failed to take out the 50 DMA at 7695 on 26 Oct. While 7695 holds as resistance, the desk targets 7645 and then 7620.
A break above 7695 would trigger a stronger rebound toward 7705 and 7755.
DAX: while 25,510 is resistance, the desk targets 25,380 and then 25,250. A break above 25,510 targets 25,540 and the 50 DMA at 25,605.
EuroStoxx50: while 6125 is resistance, the desk targets 6075 and then 6035. A break above 6125 targets 6145 and 6200.
SMI: while 14,605 is resistance, the desk targets 14,485 and then 14,410. A break above 14,605 targets 14,655 and 14,700.
Intraday trend is down for all four indices (SPX, DAX, EuroStoxx50, SMI). The 2-5 day trend is neutral for SPX and DAX, down for EuroStoxx50 and up for SMI.
